page_title: NIC 1-1 PAR | Nice v Paris FC 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' The free kick from long range, taken by Nice, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.
90+8' Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) commits a rough challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul. Nice have a free kick.
90+6' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+4' What a save from Obed Nkambadio! Isak Jansson (Nice) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out. Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+2' Sofiane Diop (Nice) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+2' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

90+1' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul after Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Nice, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Stephane Gilli is forced to make a change. Hamari Traore is unable to continue due to injury, Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) comes on.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moses Simon leaves the pitch and Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) comes on.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yehvann Diouf into the bottom left corner.
88' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
87' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Moise Bombito (Nice). The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Paris FC!!
81' Kojo Peprah (Nice) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
80' Kojo Peprah (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) replaces Willem Geubbels.
78' A substitution has been made. Adama Camara goes off and Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) comes on.
78' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Morgan Sanson comes onto the pitch to replace him.
75' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
75' Substitution. Terem Moffi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
74' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Nice earn a free kick.
70' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) makes a strong challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul. A free kick to Paris FC.
70' Paris FC take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' Here is a change. Ilan Kebbal is going off and Stephane Gilli gives the last tactical orders to Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mohamed-Ali Cho as he is replaced by Isak Jansson (Nice).
68' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle. Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) commits a foul after dangerous play. Paris FC win a free kick.
62' Moses Simon (Paris FC) is able to continue to play.
60' Moses Simon (Paris FC) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Moise Bombito (Nice) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul. Paris FC will take a free kick near the side line.
58' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
58' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
56' Paris FC can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

55' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom left corner, but Yehvann Diouf keeps it out with an amazing save. The referee points to the corner flag and Paris FC will take a corner.

55' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Yehvann Diouf.
51' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Maxime Lopez (Paris FC). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
50' Adama Camara (Paris FC) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Nice have a free kick.
48' Paris FC take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Ali Abdi will be replaced by Melvin Bard (Nice).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Salis Abdul Samed is replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
46' The whistle blows and Abdelatif Kherradji starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Nice fail to score from a corner as Obed Nkambadio (Paris FC) leaps to collect the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot towards the bottom right corner that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to pull off a marvellous diving save to keep his effort out. It will be a corner kick for Nice.

40' 1 - 0 Goal! Mohamed-Ali Cho plays in Sofiane Diop (Nice), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 1:0.
36' Moses Simon (Paris FC) makes a slide tackle, but referee Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul. Nice have been awarded a free kick.
33' The corner is swung in but Paris FC can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Paris FC have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' The game is interrupted as Terem Moffi (Nice) is flagged offside.
28' The linesman raises his flag. Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) is adjudged offside.
25' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
23' The game is interrupted now, Hamari Traore (Paris FC) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) was quite harsh and Abdelatif Kherradji didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

23' Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Paris FC, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
20' Kojo Peprah (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Abdelatif Kherradji saw the whole situation. Paris FC are awarded the free kick.

16' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Free kick. Paris FC will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
13' Yellow card. Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
13' It looks like Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) saw red with that tackle. Abdelatif Kherradji won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Nice.
11' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Nice win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
8' Abdelatif Kherradji couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) and blew his whistle. Nice will take a free kick.
6' The referee blows his whistle as Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Nice in a dangerous position.
5' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

3' Terem Moffi (Nice) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
3' The linesman points to the corner flag, Nice are going to take it.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nice will kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will officiate today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
